Name: Bigger Better Bundles by glymr (Vanilla Version)
Author: glymr
Description:
[b]IMPORTANT:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]This mod must be used with a NEW playthrough. If you install it on an existing save, it WILL have bad effects! It WILL break your save!
[*]Do NOT choose "Remixed Bundles" during save setup. This mod is designed to replace the original, vanilla bundles.
[*]Install ONLY ONE Bundle Replacement Mod. You cannot install two different bundle replacements
NOTE: If you use Stardew Valley Expanded, please note that the most recent version changes the bundles, and that this is on by default. Please use GMCM from the MAIN MENU (gear icon on the left side) or edit your Stardew Valley Expanded config file BEFORE starting a new game with my bundle set. SVE Community Bundles and Hard SVE Community Bundles must both be set to FALSE, again [b]before[/b] starting a new game. Trying to use both sets WILL cause problems. I will be creating my own SDV Expanded version of Bigger Better Bundles in the future which you can use for a Year 1 challenge. 

[/list]Do you love bundles? Have you ever put winter root in a seed maker to try to finish the Community Center before Winter 1? Were you disappointed by the lack of variety in the remixed bundle options?

Do you hate bundles? Do you feel they're too repetitive and easy?

Do you want EITHER a fun new challenge, OR something to force you to slow down and take the game at a more leisurely pace?

If you answered "yes" to any of the above, this mod is for you! Check out this replacement for the Community Center AND Movie Theater bundles, with more bundles to complete and more items required.

[b]Play it for the challenge![/b] It is possible to complete all Community Center bundles in[b] Year 1[/b] and Movie Theater Bundles before the end of [b]Spring Year 2[/b] if you want a [i]challenging[/i] playthrough. (Check the [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18ukP7MPoWgOZXMZzT-pl-P6DRg9YeUus0PEa7Wg59Yg/]spreadsheet[/url] to plan your strategy - you will need it! If you don't use the spreadsheet and plan ahead, it will be very difficult, maybe impossible to complete the bundles before the end of Year One.) 

OR

[b]Slow it down![/b] If you want something that will force you to stop and smell the flowers, use this bundle set [i]without[/i] the spreadsheet and make it a more leisurely playthrough. Be warned, many bundles are dependent on season or timing, so if you miss the window, you'll [i]have[/i] to wait to complete them. 

These bundles are designed to minimize grinding while also moving the farmer toward perfection. And many bundles have fun, useful rewards!

A LOT of thought was put into these bundle sets. Here are the requirements I based them on:

[list]
[*]Year One Completable. [spoiler]Every item in the bundle is either available in the first year, or available via the reward for another bundle. For example, garlic is required in the spring crops bundle. Since garlic is not normally available until year 2, garlic seeds will be provided as a reward for an early, easily-obtained bundle. This also applies to recipes: while many dishes are required, all are either available by fall in year 1, or are dependent on friendship or skill levels. Of course, it is up to the player to increase friendship or skill levels enough to obtain the recipes! (Note: The Missing Bundle is NOT guaranteed to be Year One completable, though it might be possible. I am very interested to see how early both the Community Center and The Missing Bundle can be completed with this mod. Leave a comment and let me know how early you manage it!)[/spoiler]
[*]Challenging, but not super hard. [spoiler]What does this mean? You won't see something ridiculous like iridium-quality octopus required with this mod. Every item is obtainable with a minimum of grinding. The hardest items to obtain will be in The Missing Bundle, but even then they should be challenging but obtainable with clever playing. [/spoiler]
[*]No Grinding! [spoiler]Since I hate games that require you to do the same thing over and over again for little or unpredictable reward, I minimized it as much as possible. Most bundles only have one of each item required. Those that have multiples should be ones where it's not difficult to obtain more than one of the same item. Higher quality items will be fairly easy to obtain with fertilizer or via the right machines.[/spoiler]
[*]Minimize dependency on RNG (random number generation). [spoiler]I have tried to minimize dependency on randomly-dropped or spawned items as much as I can.[/spoiler]
[*]Completing bundles helps move the player toward Perfection. [spoiler]There are lots of dishes and craftables included in the bundles. These don't just exist to fill out the bundles, but to give the player a boost towards achieving Perfection. By the time the bundles are completed, the player will have built up their friendship with most villagers (to obtain recipes), made a decent portion of the recipes in the game, and created a large number of the craftables in the game. If the player also sells at least one of every item they're required to donate to the bundles, they'll also be far along towards a Complete Shipment. Some of the bundle rewards will also help the player toward obtaining all of the Rarecrows.[/spoiler]
[*]Bundles scale up in difficulty. [spoiler]Spring bundles and the Boiler Room bundles are deliberately easier to complete (though still much more challenging than vanilla!) As the seasons progress, the bundle requirements will scale with the player's expected progression in the game. For example, only two of each Spring Crop may be required, but 10 of each Fall Crop may be required.[/spoiler]
[*]Bundle items and rewards should feel thematically appropriate to the bundle. [spoiler]I couldn't always make this work perfectly, but I'm very proud of some of the rewards I came up with for different bundles.[/spoiler]
[*]Rewards should feel rewarding! [spoiler]Some rewards are high-value items that have no impact on actual gameplay. Some rewards may be less valuable, but hopefully useful to the player. Some rewards just exist to help buffer against the vagaries of RNG. Many rewards give the player seeds or items which are useful, valuable, and are necessary to make other bundle items. Some rewards may feel OP, but consider how much more challenging these bundles are than vanilla. Shouldn't the rewards scale appropriately as well?[/spoiler]
[*]Fun! [spoiler]This was the most important requirement of all. I wanted bundles that would be fun to complete, and now that I've play-tested it several times, I feel I've succeeded.[/spoiler]
[/list]
If you're taking on the challenge of completing this bundle set in Year One, it's HIGHLY recommended that you look at [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18ukP7MPoWgOZXMZzT-pl-P6DRg9YeUus0PEa7Wg59Yg/edit?usp=sharing]the spreadsheet[/url] to see which rewards are available for which bundles and plan accordingly. This bundle set will require a thoughtful and careful approach to succeed.

I have play tested this bundle set thoroughly and with a minimum of QoL mods (no Automate or Tractor, though I do use Auto Axe, Auto Hoe, etc because I have carpal tunnel syndrome and repetitive clicking is bad for me). I can promise that the CC [i]is[/i] completable in Year One, even with the challenging requirements in this bundle set. I was able to complete it by [b]Winter 21, Year One[/b] (can you do better? ;) I was also able to complete the Movie Theater by the [b]end of Spring, Year Two[/b], even with the very challenging requirements (hint: some of the higher level rewards from the Community Center can help with completing these tricky bundles). I have NOT tried it on an otherwise mod-free run, though I'm interested in how early it can be completed with no help at all from Quality of Life mods. Please comment and tell me how early you manage to complete the Community Center and the Movie Theater! ([i]Can BOTH be done before the end of Y1???[/i]) 

I'm currently working on other versions of the BBB mod, including ones for SVE, RSV, East Scarp, Chocolate Valley, Dwarven Expansion, and more! Be sure to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/glymr?gameId=1303]Track Me[/url] if you want to be notified when they're released. Leave me a comment to tell me which version you'd like to see next!

If you're looking for a fun challenge, or if you're just tired of the same old bundles, give this mod a try! And if you like this mod, it would make me very happy if you would endorse it. <3  Thank you!

If you use a custom UI:
[spoiler]
I added three custom bundle colors for visual variety. Unfortunately, these may not show up or match with the other bundles if you use a custom user interface that re-colors or changes the bundle packages. I have added a lot of UIs as soft dependencies so that the custom bundles will at least show up, but they may not match the other bundles in style or colors. If bundles seem to be missing (most of the bundle trees should have a full nine bundles, except the vault and the Missing Bundle) please let me know which UI you're using and I'll add it. You can also try to make sure that Bigger Better Bundles loads later than the UI by putting a "Z" in front of the folder name (like "Z_Bigger Better Bundles") which might help the bundles show up. If you would like to contribute graphics that match a specific UI's bundles, please send them to me and I'll code them into the mod! The "JunimoNoteExtra.png" file in the assets folder is the image you would be replacing.

There is now a config option to switch to a more desaturated version of my custom bundles, contributed by irrlicht. Thank you, irrlicht!

Now includes built-in compatibility with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12733]Adventurer's Interface[/url]! Thank you, medicsun, for giving me permission to include your bundle sprites!
[/spoiler]

Special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/juminos?gameId=1303]junimos[/url], who made it possible to have additional bundles in the Abandoned Joja Mart! <3

A major source of inspiration for my bundle set came from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1222]Very Hard version of Community Center Bundles for 1 year challenge mod[/url]﻿. I really enjoyed playing with it, and it inspired me to build my own challenging bundle mod from scratch. 

I have provided an i18n file for translators. If you would like to post a translation, please feel free, but it must not include the code from my mod and it must require my mod as a dependency. Please do not use AI to translate it, except to check your work.
